$comment: Plan W13.X2 (with W11.S12): what the public security page and SECURITY.md promise about disclosure. scripts/security-page.mjs renders the 'Reporting and disclosure' section of /security and /he/security from this file; src/__tests__/securityTxt.test.ts checks that SECURITY.md states the same numbers in English and Hebrew and that public/.well-known/security.txt passes RFC 9116. The support period is a proposal for the owner to confirm in review (lane B2c).

support.en: While it is the newest release line, and for critical and high severity for 90 days after the next minor line ships.
support.he: כל עוד זה קו הגרסאות החדש ביותר, ותיקונים בחומרה קריטית וגבוהה עוד 90 יום אחרי שקו הגרסאות הבא יוצא.
